content:
Gov. Greg Abbott brought his statewide "Let's Roll" get-out-the-vote tour to Laredo on October 30, rallying supporters at Webb County Judge Tano Tijerina's campaign headquarters alongside State Rep. Don McLaughlin, according to KGNS.

Abbott pitched his re-election case with South Texas priorities that included property-tax relief he said would cut property taxes by $3,000 per household, the report says. He also outlined guidelines for data centers meant to preserve water, reduce electricity costs and avoid interfering with Texans' lives, along with border security enforcement, public education and economic development.

The article presents the stop as a campaign rally at a campaign headquarters, not an official government announcement, and says the tour heads to Midland on November 1 ahead of Tuesday's November 3 election. No specific time of day or street address for the Laredo stop was given in the report.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "Gov. Greg Abbott brings statewide campaign tour to Laredo," October 30, 2026

title: Abbott brings 'Let's Roll' tour to Laredo, pitches $3,000 property-tax cut
